text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a coordinated node-drain + rolling reboot across eu-west3 and us-east1 tonight 00:30-02:30 UTC. NIC microcode push + BMC touch. Expect temporary capacity loss in two small cohorts.

sam: Why both regions at once? can we split to avoid cross-region burst?

maya: We considered splitting, but the vendor microcode fixes a fabric bug that affects path negotiation between those two POPs. Doing both minimizes awkward cross-region failovers.

alex: Estimated impact numbers? need to tell SRE and Customer Success.

maya: Targeting 6 racks (cohort alpha/beta). ~12% of GPU capacity in eu-west3 and ~8% in us-east1 for the maintenance window. We expect autoscaler to backfill ~70% within 10m, rest will queue briefly.

irene: Can we prewarm KV cache and prefix cache to reduce tail-latency for tenants that get shifted?

maya: Yes — plan includes pre-seeding kvcache on adjacent pools. CMD: 
```
infractl drain --pool=cohort-alpha --grace=600 --preseed-kv=true
infractl reboot --stagger=30s --bmc=true
```

juan: Any cost upside/downsides? if backfills go to burst instances it'll bill higher.

maya: Good point — estimated billing delta ~ $1.7k for the 2h window if we use burst capacity. We prefer warm-backfill from reserved spare pools to keep costs lower; ops-team will enable burst only if queue > 60s across priority tenants.

ops-bot: deploybot: Job 1771234567 scheduled: cohort-alpha drain (00:30 UTC) -> cohort-beta drain (01:00 UTC) -> canary verification -> full reboot sweep.

sam: Canary details? what success criteria?

maya: Canary = 5 nodes from cohort-alpha. Success = no packet drops >0.1% for 15m, p99 latency increase <10ms, no CUDA kernel hangs. If canary fails we rollback microcode (fast-path) and extend maintenance window.

irene: Noted — I'll add a quick eval in Redwood Console to watch token-level latency and error spikes and webhook alerts for any regressions.

alex: Customer comm? CS wants a one-paragraph note and a list of affected tenants by SLA tier.

maya: Draft for CS: "We will perform a planned maintenance on 00:30-02:30 UTC to apply a NIC microcode fix. A small subset of capacity in eu-west3 and us-east1 will be cycled; most workloads will remain unaffected. We will use canaries and warm-backfill to limit impact. Contact support if you see sustained errors."

juan: I'll queue the billing estimate with finance and flag burst policy.

sam: If anything goes sideways, call the rollback and fall back to software path in 15m per playbook.

maya: Agreed. Playbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/infra/playbooks/node-drain-rollback (please ping me if you can't access). :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incidentbot: Reminder scheduled 00:15 UTC for preflight checklist and KV preseed job.

alex: LGTM. I'll notify SRE rotation and CS.

maya: Thanks team — will post final confirmation 30m before start.
